{{External|rs=Fremennik achievements}} {{Infobox Achievement Diary |name = Fremennik Diary |image = [[File:Fremennik Diary.png]] |release = [[5 March]] [[2015]] |update = Achievement Diaries |areas = [[Rellekka]], [[Lunar Isle]], [[Jatizso]], [[Neitiznot]], [[Keldagrim]], [[God Wars Dungeon]], [[Troll Stronghold (location)|Troll Stronghold]] |members = Yes |reward = [[Fremennik sea boots|Boots]] |taskmasters = [[Thorodin]] |leagueRegion = Fremennik }} The '''Fremennik Diary''' is an [[Achievement Diary]] whose tasks revolve around areas within the [[Fremennik Province]], such as [[Neitiznot]] and [[Jatizso]], [[Miscellania]] and [[Etceteria]], the [[God Wars Dungeon]], [[Lunar Isle]], and [[Waterbirth Island]]. Several skill, quest, and item requirements are needed to complete all tasks. Unless stated otherwise, [[temporary skill boost]]s can be used to meet the skill requirements. Rewards can be claimed from [[Thorodin]] just south of [[Rellekka]]. Tasks may be done in any order, but the previous tiers of a diary must be completed to claim rewards of the next tier. {{Map|name=Thorodin|x=2659|y=3627|align=left|width=250|height=250|r=4|mtype=square|caption=Thorodin's location}}{{Clear|left}} ==Overview== {{Sync}} |-| Easy= {| class="diary-table" style="text-align:center;" | style="vertical-align:top" | {{DiarySkillStats |margin=no |maxrefs=2 |boostable=true |selectable=true |Mining = 20 |Smithing = 20 |Thieving = 5 |Crafting = 23 |Firemaking = 15 |Woodcutting = 15 |Hunter = 11 |Total = 134 }} | width="225px" style="vertical-align:top;" | {| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active" style="width:inherit;" !Quest requirements |- data-rowid="The Fremennik Trials" |[[The Fremennik Trials]] |} | width="400px" style="vertical-align:top" | {| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active" !Additional requirements |- |Started [[The Giant Dwarf]] |- |Started [[Troll Stronghold]] |} |} |-| Medium= {| class="diary-table" style="text-align:center;" | style="vertical-align:top" | {{DiarySkillStats |margin=no |maxrefs=2 |boostable=true |selectable=true |Mining = 40 |Agility = 35 |Smithing = 50 |Defence = 30 |Thieving = 42 |Crafting = 31 |Firemaking = 40 |Woodcutting = 50 |Slayer = 47 |Construction = 37 |Hunter = 35 |Total = 458 }} | width="225px" style="vertical-align:top;" | {| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active" style="width:inherit;" !
